status: defined: immutable inputs and independently checkable expectations; reference pages checked in Chromium (reference-check.v1.json); negative fixtures executed against the Alpha 1 build; product oracle execution belongs to the owning lots
policy: Reference pages are authored outcomes, not compiler output. A future implementation reproduces them through the design system; it never edits them to match.

Each positive fixture states success separately for accepted vocabulary (E2), expected CSS (E3), geometry, text wrapping, state behavior, keyboard, accessibility and CSP (E4). Passing one class says nothing about another.
Inputs are pinned by SHA-256 and are immutable. Changing an expectation or an input needs a reviewed reason, like an expectation edit in the semantic migration oracle.
Every declaration of every reference stylesheet is accounted for in accounting.v1.json, composites included, against the Alpha 1 policy and the CE-00.1 registry.

Negative fixtures record the intended rejection, which must hold after every core-evolution lot, separately from the observed Alpha 1 behavior, which tests/core-evolution/run-negatives.mjs executes against the workspace compiler build. An observed acceptance is a recorded compiler defect with an owning lot, never a met expectation.
Reference pages are rendered and checked by tests/core-evolution/check-references.mjs in a pinned Chromium; that checks the authored outcomes only, not any build.
Consumer calibration sets are measurement inputs for the classifier only. They carry no rendering expectation.

expect.declarationsEquivalent: font: inherit expands to its seven longhands, each inherit

assertions.note: The only composite form in the corpus fixtures.
overflow-wrap: anywhere in a 240px viewport.
Disabled controls keep transform: none under :active.
The select inside the disabled fieldset and the disabled button are skipped; the aria-disabled busy button stays focusable.
Removing every focus indicator keeps :focus-visible matching; the painted-indicator check must still fail.

mutation.css: [data-testid="input-email"]:focus-visible { opacity: 0 !important; outline: 3px solid blue !important; box-shadow: none !important; }

assertions.note: The focused element becomes invisible; its disappearance changes ring pixels but paints no indicator.

mutation.css: [data-testid="input-email"]:focus-visible { filter: opacity(0) !important; outline: 3px solid blue !important; box-shadow: none !important; }

assertions.note: filter: opacity(0) hides the focused element and its outline.

mutation.css: [data-testid="field-email"]:focus-within { opacity: 0 !important; } [data-testid="input-email"]:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid blue !important; box-shadow: none !important; }

assertions.note: An ancestor with opacity 0 hides the focused element and its outline.

mutation.css: [data-testid="input-email"]:focus-visible { clip-path: inset(50%) !important; outline: 3px solid white !important; box-shadow: none !important; }

assertions.note: clip-path clips the focused element and its white outline; the clipped area changes ring pixels but no indicator paint shows.

mutation.css: [data-testid="input-email"]:focus-visible { mask-image: linear-gradient(transparent, transparent) !important; outline: 3px solid blue !important; box-shadow: none !important; }

assertions.note: A transparent mask hides the focused element and its outline.

mutation.css: [data-testid="field-email"]:focus-within { position: relative !important; } [data-testid="field-email"]:focus-within::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -24px; background: white; z-index: 10; } [data-testid="input-email"]:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid blue !important; box-shadow: none !important; }

assertions.note: A white overlay covers the focused element and its outline.

mutation.css: [data-testid="input-email"]:focus-visible { transform: scale(0) !important; outline: 3px solid blue !important; box-shadow: none !important; }

assertions.note: transform: scale(0) collapses the focused element and its outline.

mutation.css: [data-testid="input-email"]:focus-visible { position: relative !important; left: -10000px !important; outline: 3px solid blue !important; box-shadow: none !important; }

assertions.note: The focused element and its outline move off screen.
